info.title: Lattiz API
info.description: Lattiz resource server. Auth is handled by Supabase; this API only validates Supabase-issued JWTs (JWKS / ES256, audience `authenticated`).

date.description: Calendar day in the GA property time zone, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

sharePct.description: Share of all sessions in the window, 0–100.

sessionsDeltaPct.description: Null when the previous period had zero sessions.

daily.description: Exactly `rangeDays` points, oldest first, gap-filled with zeros.

stale.description: True when the Data API failed and an expired cached report is served instead.

retryAvailableAt.description: When `POST /analytics/retry` will be accepted again (only for `failed`).

coveredByPlan.description: Whether the Lattiz plan absorbs the cost (price <= DOMAIN_MAX_COST_USD_CENTS).

agreementTypes.description: Agreement types the user accepted — must match the quote's requiredAgreements.

agreedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the user actually clicked "Acepto" — never fabricated.

priceUsdCents.description: Price the user saw in the quote, in USD cents; the purchase is rejected if the current price is higher.

jobId.description: Poll GET /domains/jobs/:jobId with this id for pipeline progress.

domain.description: Domain the tenant already owns at another registrar, e.g. "miempresa.com".

name.description: '@' for the apex, 'www' for the subdomain.

dnsInstructions.description: DNS records the tenant must create manually at their registrar.

relaunched.description: False when there was nothing to relaunch (no domain, or not suspended).

id.description: Profile id (matches the Supabase user id).

sub.description: Supabase user id (the `sub` claim of the verified JWT).

email.description: Email claim, when present in the token.

claims.description: The full set of verified JWT claims.

profile.description: Application profile, or null if none exists yet.

project.description: The GrapesJS project JSON to load into the editor (`storage.project`).
The full GrapesJS project JSON (editor state) to persist.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the persisted change.

project.description: The GrapesJS project JSON (editor state) at publish time.

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp the site was published.

id.description: Stable id for the asset in the GrapesJS asset manager.

src.description: Public Supabase Storage URL, embedded as-is in the exported HTML.

templateId.description: Id of the template to seed the tenant's site from.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the site schema was created.

templateId.description: Id of the template to switch the tenant's site to.

confirm.description: Must be true when the site already has content, to acknowledge the reset.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the persisted change.

suspended.description: Vercel mapping removed after a lapsed subscription; DNS and ownership are intact.

createdAt.description: Set once, at `site_schemas` row creation — lets callers detect edits (`updatedAt !== createdAt`).

socialPreviewUrl.description: Null means the tenant site falls back to the auto-generated OG image.

seoTitle.description: Null means the tenant site falls back to the tenant name.

seoDescription.description: Null means the tenant site falls back to a generic description.

ogSiteName.description: Null means og:site_name falls back to the resolved title.

tenantId.description: `tenants.id` — the id expected by the editor route (`/editor/:tenantId`).

previewUrl.description: `https://{slug}.lattiz.app`; serves the published site until a custom domain is live.

slugIsCustom.description: False while the address is still the one generated at signup.

domainStatus.description: Provisioning state of the purchased domain (null until one is bought).

isEntitled.description:
Whether the tenant may use the service right now. Top-level rather than
inside `subscription`, which is null exactly when a tenant has none —
the case that most needs the flag. The only value the guard and the
frontend trust; never recompute the date math anywhere else.

branding.description: Favicon / social-preview images injected into the published tenant site.

slug.description: Desired address; normalized and validated server-side so every failure carries a stable code.

previewUrl.description: Where the site is reachable before (or without) a custom domain.

slug.description: The normalized address that was checked.

available.description: True when the caller can claim it (including the address they already own).

reason.description: Why it cannot be claimed; null when available.

url.description: Public Supabase Storage URL, versioned so a replacement busts the CDN cache.
